decisive_items: multinodular proliferation of osteoclastlike multinucleated giant cells and mononuclear cells
negative for CD45, S100, desmin, and lysozyme
response.rationale: Giant cell tumor is strongly supported by the classic histology of osteoclastlike giant cells and mononuclear cells, with CD68 positivity and S100 negativity fitting the immunophenotype. In contrast, Langerhans cell histiocytosis is essentially excluded by negative S100, and Rosai-Dorfman disease is less likely given its typical S100 positivity.

rejected.why: Negative S100 contradicts Langerhans cell histiocytosis, which is typically S100 positive.
Rosai-Dorfman disease is usually S100 positive; the negative S100 makes this diagnosis less likely than giant cell tumor.
